target_name: Net serial equity dilution under chronic shortfall
rationale: This is a cosmetic variant of the archive's "Serial dilution with chronic cash shortfall" — identical moderator, identical 3-year window, with only prstkc netted out of the numerator — and the resulting net-equity-issuance construct is itself close to the well-known net share issuance / composite issuance anomaly.

GROWTH(csho,3) is a direct restatement of the published share-issuance/composite-issuance anomaly, and unadjusted csho growth is badly contaminated by splits and stock dividends, so the "clean attribution test" against signal 1 would be confounded by a measurement artifact rather than the economic channel.

Recasting issuance as a five-year count of material raises is a genuinely different design axis (habituality vs. magnitude) that plausibly fixes the right-skew problem behind the weak FMB slopes, though the five-year history requirement will likely shrink already-thin coverage and the coarse 0–5 count may produce lumpy, tie-heavy portfolio sorts.

target_name: Cumulative issuance against an operating cash-burn streak
rationale: Swapping the moderator from a liquidity stock to a cash-flow-persistence state is a defensible substantive change, but the proposal's diagnosis (accruals vs. cash) likely misidentifies the earlier failure — the 0/1/2/3 count multiplier reintroduces the same large mass of exact zeros that collapses the long leg and produced the contradictory FMB/alpha signs in the gen-0 loss-streak version.

Using gross dltr rather than net retirement, with a liquidity-shortfall weight and a reversed expected sign, is a coherent and previously untested economic reading that directly rationalizes why the archive's net-deleveraging signals had slopes but no alpha; the main risk is that gross dltr proxies mechanically for debt level and short maturity structure rather than funding stress.

The MIN-based overlap construct is a genuinely novel interaction for this archive, but for most dividend payers sstk consists of routine option-exercise and DRIP proceeds, so the MIN will usually bind on incidental issuance rather than the deliberate round-tripping the hypothesis describes, and the surviving population may be dominated by utilities/REITs — an industry-composition risk worth an IND_RANK control.
